snippet.title: Slydris Trailer (iPad)
snippet.description:
(Coming soon to iPhone by popular request)

Slydris is an elegant and unique puzzle game for iPad from Radiangames.  Slide and drop blocks to create complete rows.  Includes two major modes (Infinite and Survival) along with a Zen Mode.  Also has Game Center achievements and leaderboards, iCloud saving, and iPad Retina Display support.

http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/slydris/id509213094?mt=8
